boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Loras College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Dubuque food stops with late service verified on current official location pages. Check the cited page before leaving because hours can change.

cards.title: South Locust After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Drive-through food until 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes, and confirm transportation before making the trip south from campus.
cards.short_summary: The latest-closing verified option on this board serves through 2 a.m. nightly and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through service until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 240 South Locust Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Dubuque, IA — 240 South Locust Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are 9:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; posted dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Hillcrest’s Weekend Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service as late as 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Save this west-side stop for a night with a driver; the official schedule makes the Friday–Saturday window the longest.
cards.short_summary: This Hillcrest Road location extends its drive-through schedule by two hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through service until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 3300 Hillcrest Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Dubuque, IA — 3300 Hillcrest Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are 8:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Central Avenue Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: A close-to-campus counter open until 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Order before walking or driving over, then use the official location page to recheck the nightly cutoff and pickup status.
cards.short_summary: The Central Avenue Domino’s provides a named late pizza destination on the downtown side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 2013 Central Avenue identifies the Dubuque store and reports that it is open until 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2013 Central | Domino's in Dubuque
cards.access_notes: The official location page reports service until 2:00 a.m.; confirm the current day’s order and carryout availability before departing.

cards.entity_name: Domino's Pizza — 1685 John F. Kennedy Road
cards.title: JFK Road Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: Late pizza service on Dubuque’s west side
cards.notes: Place the order first and treat this as a vehicle trip; check whether late service is delivery, counter pickup, or both that night.
cards.short_summary: A second official Domino’s location gives the board a distinct west-side late-order option.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies its store at 1685 John F. Kennedy Road in Dubuque and reports that it is open until 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1685 John F Kennedy Rd | Domino's in Dubuque
cards.access_notes: The official location page reports service until 2:00 a.m.; verify the current day’s carryout or delivery window before ordering.

cards.title: Pennsylvania Avenue Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: Carryout near 1 a.m. and later weekend delivery
cards.notes: Choose carryout only if transportation is settled; otherwise compare the posted delivery cutoff with your campus address first.
cards.short_summary: Late delivery and carryout schedules make this Pennsylvania Avenue shop useful after conventional dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns’ official page lists delivery until 1:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday at 3301 Pennsylvania Avenue.
cards.source_title: Food Near Me in Dubuque, IA | Papa Johns Pennsylvania Ave
cards.access_notes: Delivery ends at 1:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday; carryout closes 15 minutes earlier most nights.

cards.title: Midnight Sit-Down on Plaza Drive
cards.subtitle: A dining room scheduled through midnight daily
cards.notes: Use this for a seated meal rather than a drive-through stop, and confirm the midnight closing time before heading across town.
cards.short_summary: Perkins supplies the board’s clearest verified late sit-down restaurant rather than a delivery or drive-through counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins’ official Dubuque location page lists restaurant hours of 5:30 a.m. to midnight every day at 2785 Plaza Drive.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 2785 Plaza Drive Dubuque, IA | Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.access_notes: The dining room is listed as open 5:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Sunday–Saturday; verify holiday or temporary changes before leaving.

cards.title: Rockdale’s 24-Hour Counter
cards.subtitle: Around-the-clock store, pickup, and delivery
cards.notes: Check the live ordering page for kitchen availability, and plan this south-side destination as a drive or delivery run.
cards.short_summary: This Rockdale Road Casey’s explicitly lists 24/7 store access, pickup, delivery, and prepared-food categories.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey’s official location page lists the 2699 Rockdale Road store, pickup, delivery, and pumps as operating 24/7.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Dubuque, IA | Casey's — 2699 Rockdale Rd
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store hours, pickup, delivery, and pumps as 24/7; confirm individual kitchen-item availability when ordering.

cards.title: Peru Road Around the Clock
cards.subtitle: A second verified 24/7 convenience stop
cards.notes: Use the official order page to confirm what the kitchen is serving late, and arrange a vehicle for this north-side destination.
cards.short_summary: The Peru Road Casey’s offers another documented all-night option, separated geographically from the Rockdale store.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey’s official location page lists the 4003 Peru Road store, pickup, delivery, and pumps as operating 24/7.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Dubuque, IA | Casey's — 4003 Peru Rd
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store hours, pickup, delivery, and pumps as 24/7; late-night prepared-food selection may vary.

cards.title: Holliday Drive Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service later than the lobby
cards.notes: Arrive by car after 10 p.m.; the official schedule shows the lobby closing before the late drive-through window begins.
cards.short_summary: This McDonald’s distinguishes lobby and drive-through hours, with the latter reaching midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists drive-through service until 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday at 2060 Holliday Drive.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Dubuque, IA at 2060 Holliday Drive | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The lobby closes at 10:00 p.m.; drive-through service ends at 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: 20th Street’s Late Taco Window
cards.subtitle: Open until 11 p.m. Thursday through Saturday
cards.notes: Make this the earlier run of the night and check the weekday carefully, since the extended hour applies only Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: The East 20th Street location offers an officially documented 11 p.m. closing on three nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco John’s official location page lists the 17 East 20th Street restaurant as open until 11:00 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco John's | 17 E 20th St — Tacos, Burritos, Potato Olés
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours end at 11:00 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday; confirm the posted day before leaving.
